# Encore Profile Server (`grusell-encore-profile-server`)

Transform your video processing with the Encore Profile Server. Serve dynamic transcoding profiles directly from S3-compatible storage, seamlessly integrating AI capabilities for on-demand profile creation.

[Source](https://github.com/grusell/encore-profile-server)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "grusell-encore-profile-server"
  name       = "myserver"

  parameters = {
    # s3Endpoint      = "..."
    # s3Region        = "..."
    # s3AccessKey     = "..."
    # s3SecretKey     = "..."
    # s3Bucket        = "..."
    # s3Prefix        = "..."
    # anthropicApiKey = "..."
    # anthropicModel  = "..."
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `s3Endpoint` | string | no | The endpoint URL for the S3-compatible storage service where Encore transcoding profiles are stored |
| `s3Region` | string | no | The AWS region or region identifier for the S3-compatible storage service |
| `s3AccessKey` | string | no | The access key ID for authenticating with the S3-compatible storage service |
| `s3SecretKey` | string | no | The secret access key for authenticating with the S3-compatible storage service |
| `s3Bucket` | string | no | The name of the S3 bucket containing the Encore transcoding profile files (YAML/JSON) |
| `s3Prefix` | string | no | Optional prefix path within the S3 bucket to limit profile file discovery to a specific directory/folder |
| `anthropicApiKey` | string | no | API key for accessing Anthropic's Claude AI service to enable AI-powered profile generation via the /feelinglucky endpoint |
| `anthropicModel` | string | no | Specifies which Claude AI model to use for generating Encore transcoding profiles |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
